episodes.name: Unedited Jim Cramer Interview
episodes.overview: The unedited version of Jon Stewart's interview with Jim Cramer of CNBC. Comes after several shows in which Stewart criticised the financial network of failing in their journalistic duty to warn investors, instead acting as shills for the financial industry. While Cramer's antics on his own show were highlighted, the argument was not solely with Cramer per se, but rather the whole CNBC shtick.

In "O'Reilly v Stewart 2012: The Rumble in the Air-Conditioned Auditorium," O'Reilly and Stewart took an entertaining and comedic approach to today's pressing political issues in an attempt to find the best direction for America. The debate was recorded live at Lisner Auditorium at The George Washington University.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Roy Wood Jr
episodes.overview: A look back at correspondent Roy Wood Jr.'s coverage of topics such as Meals on Wheels and blackness at the Oscars.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Ronny Chieng
episodes.overview: The show salutes correspondent Ronny Chieng's reporting as he covers Fox News' racism, an interfaith initiative and Donald Trump's China policy.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Desi Lydic
episodes.overview: The show looks back at correspondent Desi Lydic's most memorable moments and most noteworthy stories.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Hasan Minhaj
episodes.overview: The show looks back at correspondent Hasan Minhaj's most memorable moments and most noteworthy stories.

episodes.name: The Second 100 Days
episodes.overview: Trevor recaps President Trump's biggest accomplishments (and non-accomplishments) during his second 100 days in office, from foreign policy to health care to the environment.

episodes.name: The Russian Scandal: The Crème de la Kremlin
episodes.overview: The Daily Show looks at the many ways Donald Trump and his staff have gotten wrapped up in Russia-related scandals since he began his run for the U.S. presidency.

episodes.name: Trump's Best, Smartest People. Such Great People.
episodes.overview: Trevor runs through the slew of dubiously qualified people President Trump has hired to run his administration and examines their most egregious gaffes and blunders.

episodes.name: Start Dreading the News
episodes.overview: Trevor analyzes the state of news media with a look at the recent shakeups at Fox News, the effect President Trump has had on punditry and the rise of Alex Jones.

episodes.name: The Yearly Show 2017
episodes.overview: Trevor and the Best F#@king News Team hit the Gramercy Theatre to look back at the biggest events of 2017 in news, sports and pop culture.

episodes.name: You're Fired: In Memoriam
episodes.overview: The Daily Show looks back on the government employees (like Sean Spicer and Preet Bharara) who didn’t make it through President Trump’s first year in office.

episodes.name: It's the End of the Year As We Know It
episodes.overview: The Daily Show reflects on some of the year’s most disastrous events, including a record-breaking hurricane season and escalating tensions between the U.S. and North Korea.

episodes.name: Out of Office 2017
episodes.overview: The Daily Show highlights some of its best field pieces from the past year, including a look at how President Trump’s words get translated into other languages and an investigation into a jobs program in coal country.

episodes.name: The Russian Scandal: The Crème De La Kremlin II
episodes.overview: The Daily Show unpacks the biggest moments from the Trump-Russia investigation, including Donald Trump Jr.’s campaign meeting, the Kremlin’s social media takeover and Robert Mueller’s indictments.

episodes.name: Ladies Night: News-making women
episodes.overview: The Daily Show highlights news-making women, including the black female voters in Alabama who defeated accused child molester Roy Moore, the Miss America contestants with more qualifications than President Trump and (of course) Oprah Winfrey.

episodes.name: My Super Tweet 16
episodes.overview: Trevor and The World’s Fakest News Team revisit Donald Trump’s most memorable early tweets, explain why the president gravitates toward an unfiltered communications platform and suggest alternate social media for threatening war.

episodes.name: A 100% Trump-Free Show
episodes.overview: In an entirely Donald Trump-free episode, Trevor and The World’s Fakest News Team find out how rowdy Ugandan politics can get, learn about the latest smart technology and check in with Rob Gronkowski on the Tide Pod Challenge.

episodes.name: The Unpresidential Day Special
episodes.overview: In honor of Presidents’ Day, The Daily Show looks back at some of Donald Trump’s most memorable moments in office, from defending white supremacists to administration infighting to attacking the “fake news” media.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Roy Wood Jr. Vol. 2
episodes.overview: A look back on some of Roy Wood Jr.’s finest segments to date, including reportage from a pro-gun rally after the Parkland shooting and a State of Black S**t address.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Desi Lydic Vol. 2
episodes.overview: A selection of Desi Lydic’s best reporting, from visiting a sex robot factory to interviewing translators tasked with making sense of Donald Trump’s speeches.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Ronny Chieng Vol. 2
episodes.overview: Some of Ronny Chieng’s best segments, including a profile of the wrestler The Progressive Liberal and an inside look at the world of cryptocurrency.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Dulcé Sloan
episodes.overview: Some of Dulce Sloan’s finest segments, including her trip to the U.S.-Mexico border and a postmortem on the defeat of Roy Moore.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Michael Kosta
episodes.overview: Some of Michael Kosta’s best work, from a legal analysis of a corrupt Alabama sheriff to a problematic bus tour of New York City.

episodes.name: Separation Anxiety
episodes.overview: Trevor examines President Trump’s reviled policy of separating migrant families, from the bipartisan backlash against it to the White House’s efforts to blame it on Democrats.

episodes.name: Discrimi-NATION
episodes.overview: Trevor examines the rise of white people calling the cops on black people for no reason, inappropriate school assignments involving slavery, and Roseanne Barr’s racist tweet.

episodes.name: So Much Winning
episodes.overview: Trevor covers Donald Trump’s history of lying about his wealth, the president’s “Space Force” plan, and the implications of Anthony Kennedy’s retirement from the Supreme Court.

episodes.name: In The Foxhole
episodes.overview: President Trump’s nightly chats with Sean Hannity wreak havoc, Laura Ingraham defends the separation of migrant families, and Trump delivers a wild rant on “Fox & Friends.”

episodes.name: Big Little Allies
episodes.overview: A look at the tactless and flat-out weird way Donald Trump has engaged with world leaders since he became president.

episodes.name: A 100% Trump-Free Show Vol. 2
episodes.overview: A much-needed reprieve from Donald Trump-centric news, including speculation about Bert and Ernie, and deer overpopulation in Staten Island.

episodes.name: Filling the Swamp
episodes.overview: Taking stock of some of the most corrupt and unqualified people to make it into Donald Trump’s orbit, including Scott Pruitt, Stephen Miller, and Brett Kavanaugh.

episodes.name: A Total Shutshow
episodes.overview: The Daily Show looks back at President Trump’s mismanagement of the longest shutdown in American history.

episodes.name: This Is U.S.
episodes.overview: The Daily Show revisits some notable local news stories, including a pet alligator in a nursing home and the lifting of a nunchucks ban.

episodes.name: The Russian Scandal: The Creme de la Kremlin III
episodes.overview: The Daily Show provides an update on Robert Mueller’s investigation and President Trump’s suspicious string of pro-Russia stances.

episodes.name: You're Fired: In Memoriam Vol. 2
episodes.overview: The Daily Show tips its hat to another round of Trump appointees who either resigned or were fired, including Omarosa Manigault, Rex Tillerson, and Jeff Sessions.

episodes.name: The Daily Show Presents: Desi Lydic: Abroad
episodes.overview: Desi Lydic heads to Iceland, Namibia and Spain to figure out why these countries all have better records of gender equality than the United States.

episodes.name: What in the World?
episodes.overview: The Daily Show revisits outrageous news stories from around the world, including a pole-dancing controversy in China and professional lightsaber dueling in France.

episodes.name: It's 2020 24/7
episodes.overview: The Daily Show provides an overview of some of the many, many Democrats running for president in 2020, including Bernie Sanders, Joe Biden, Pete Buttigieg and Kamala Harris.

episodes.name: The Kid Gloves Come Off
episodes.overview: The Daily Show highlights young people taking an outsized role in politics, including teen activists from Parkland and kids who challenged Dianne Feinstein on climate change.

episodes.name: In the Foxhole Vol. 2
episodes.overview: The Daily Show highlights Fox News at its most outrageous, including Sean Hannity losing it over Cory Booker’s veganism and Laura Ingraham’s feud with Pete Buttigieg.

episodes.name: Beast of Special
episodes.overview: The Daily Show looks back at the wildest recent animal news, including a tiger left in an abandoned house, a dog that can perform CPR and a pair of gay lions.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Michael Kosta Vol. 2
episodes.overview: The Daily Show pays tribute to Michael Kosta’s best work, including his case for reparations and his look at how Trump supporters feel about the Space Force.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Dulcé Sloan Vol. 2
episodes.overview: The Daily Show salutes Dulcé Sloan’s finest work, from her take on black women’s support of Joe Biden to their call for equal pay.

episodes.name: Donsplaining
episodes.overview: The Daily Show puzzles over some of Donald Trump’s most baffling attempts to explain how the world works, including his takes on 5G, windmills, trade deals, and more.

episodes.name: Leading Ladies
episodes.overview: The Daily Show looks at some of the ways women are combating sexism, including the battle against the pink tax and the U.S. Women’s National Soccer Team’s stand for equal pay.

episodes.name: Your Moment of Them: The Best of Jaboukie Young-White
episodes.overview: The Daily Show celebrates correspondent Jaboukie Young-White’s best work, including his trip to the Pittsburgh Equality March and his look at socialism’s rising popularity.

episodes.name: Crazy Rich Nation
episodes.overview: The Daily Show takes a look at the shady business that rich people have been up to lately, including Robert Kraft’s prostitution charges and the college admissions bribery scandal.

episodes.overview: Jordan Klepper visits Pennsylvania, Michigan and Arizona to observe a GOP gripped by election denial and conspiracy theories, and Congressman Adam Kinzinger discusses the state of democracy.

episodes.name: The Daily Show Presents: Jordan Klepper Fingers The Pulse: Rally Together
episodes.overview: Jordan Klepper has traveled all over America, covering more Trump rallies than anyone else. In this special, he invites curious experts and celebrities to join him at Trump events in three swing states for a wild ride towards Election Day.

episodes.name: The Daily Show Presents a Live Election Night Special With Jon Stewart: Indecision 2024: Nothing We Can Do About It Now
episodes.overview: Jon and The Daily Show News Team cover America’s election with up-to-the-minute results and interviews with Gov. Katie Hobbs, and Lt. Gov. Garlin Gilchrist II.

episodes.name: Jordan Klepper Fingers the Pulse: MAGA: The Next Generation
episodes.overview: The Daily Show” tackles the curious case of young MAGA voters in a special episode airing this Monday. Following the 2024 election, where Donald Trump performed better with voters under 30 than any Republican since 2008, correspondent Jordan Klepper sets out to understand this surprising demographic trend. Did economic worries drive young people to Trump, or is it simply his particular brand of charisma? And is it a trend, or something more permanent?

episodes.name: Jordan Klepper Fingers the Pulse: Give the Man a Prize
episodes.overview: Donald Trump is a man of peace, but will it earn him the Nobel Peace Prize he so violently demands? In this half-hour special, Jordan Klepper goes on a quest that sends him across America and Norway to talk to MAGA supporters, naked bike riders, costumed protestors, and even a Nobel Committee alum.
